facts.text: Rancho Valencia is a Spanish Colonial hacienda-inspired enclave in the heart of Rancho Santa Fe, in north San Diego County.
facts.excerpt: This Spanish Colonial Hacienda-inspired enclave in the heart of Rancho Santa Fe, (north San Diego County)

facts.text: The resort sits on 45 acres of lush gardens and citrus groves.
facts.excerpt: Situated across 45 acres of lush gardens and citrus groves

facts.text: Rancho Valencia is a Relais & Chateaux property.
facts.excerpt: AN AWARD-WINNING RELAIS & CHATEAUX LUXURY RESORT

facts.text: Rancho Valencia opened in 1989.
facts.excerpt: Since its opening in 1989

facts.text: The all-suite property near Del Mar underwent a complete renovation in 2013.
facts.excerpt: all-suite property near Del Mar, California underwent a complete renovation in 2013

facts.text: Guest casitas have their own patios and fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: luxuriously-appointed guest casitas with their own patios and fireplaces

facts.text: Fresh-squeezed orange or wellness juice is delivered each morning to the casita's private patio, which has two chaise lounges, a fireplace and a breakfast table.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy fresh-squeezed orange or wellness juice, delivered each morning, on your private patio appointed with two chaise lounges, fireplace, and a breakfast table.

facts.text: The Palm suites have a sunken living room with a fireplace and vaulted ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Sunken living room with fireplace and vaulted ceilings

facts.text: The Hacienda is a private adobe home with a full kitchen, wood-burning fireplaces in almost every room and three separate bedroom suites.
facts.excerpt: The Rancho Valencia Hacienda offers a full kitchen, wood-burning fireplaces in almost every room and three separate bedroom suites, each with a deluxe private bath.

facts.text: The Hacienda has its own private outdoor pool and spa.
facts.excerpt: slip into your private outdoor pool and spa

facts.text: Casa Valencia is a five-bedroom private residence that combines Mexican-Moroccan styling with luxury.
facts.excerpt: This lavish five-bedroom private residence combines Mexican-Morrocan styling with absolute luxury

facts.text: The spa's hydrotherapy circuit includes outdoor steam, sauna, cold plunge and hand-painted tiled whirlpools with fountains.
facts.excerpt: Rancho Valencia’s Hydrotherapy Circuit offers these therapies in a tranquil and lush atmosphere with outdoor steam, sauna, cold plunge, and hand-painted tiled whirlpools with soothing fountains.

facts.text: The Spa includes the Serenity Yoga Pavilion and a Pilates studio.
facts.excerpt: Serenity Yoga Pavilion, Pilates studio

facts.text: There is an adults-only Spa Pool and a family-friendly Resort Pool.
facts.excerpt: Join us at the adults-only Spa Pool or family-friendly Resort Pool

facts.text: The Spa Pool has private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: relax by the Spa Pool, complete with private cabanas

facts.text: The racquet facilities include Plexipave championship tennis courts, European red clay courts, padel courts and pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: 12 beautiful Plexipave championship courts, 3 European Red Clay courts, 3 Padel courts and 4 Pickleball courts

facts.text: Racquet sports are offered for all levels and ages, with group clinics, private training and match play.
facts.excerpt: Available for all levels and ages, we offer group clinics, private training, and recreational match play on our Padel, Pickleball, and Tennis courts.

facts.text: The Pony Room serves craft cocktails, tequila and fresh Coastal Ranch cuisine in a candlelit modern hacienda setting.
facts.excerpt: candlelit modern hacienda setting serving up imaginative craft cocktails and tequila alongside fresh Coastal Ranch cuisine

facts.text: The Pony Room bar offers 100 variations of tequila.
facts.excerpt: 100 variations of tequila

facts.text: The resort's surf school teaches beginners and intermediates at Del Mar Beach.
facts.excerpt: mellow beginner and intermediate waves at Del Mar Beach are perfect for learning to surf

facts.text: The resort can arrange beach days at local beaches in Del Mar, Solana Beach and Cardiff.
facts.excerpt: Spend a day at our local beaches in Del Mar, Solana Beach, and Cardiff.

facts.text: Callaway golf clubs are complimentary with a stay.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the use of top of the line Callaway golf clubs, complimentary with your stay!

facts.text: Guests can explore Rancho Santa Fe on resort bicycles.
facts.excerpt: Explore the beautiful surroundings in Rancho Santa Fe and pedal off with our resort bicycles.

facts.text: Concierge can arrange day trips to the Valle de Guadalupe wine country and Temecula.
facts.excerpt: Discover the enchanting Ruta del Vino and world-class wines of the Valle de Guadalupe just south of the border, or explore our “local” vineyards of Temecula

facts.text: Guests must be 18 to use the fitness center and spa amenities.
facts.excerpt: Must be 18 years of age to enjoy fitness center and spa amenities.

facts.text: The spa received a major renovation in 2020 and 2021.
facts.excerpt: 2020 and 2021 brought about further enhancements to our San Diego resort, including a major renovation of the gorgeous Forbes 5-star rated Spa

facts.text: Daily fitness classes include yoga, Pilates, TRX, aqua and outdoor classes.
facts.excerpt: including Yoga, Pilates, Cardio, Sculpt, TRX, Restorative, Aqua, and Outdoor classes

facts.excerpt: Southern California’s only Relais & Châteaux property

facts.text: The local beaches are a short ride from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Just a short ride from the resort, these world-class beaches
